data.name: Aabir
data.gender_notes: Aabir is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From Arabic ʿābir (عابر) 'one who crosses, passer-by', the active participle of ʿabara 'to cross, to pass through', from the root ʿ-b-r. The same root gives ʿibra 'lesson, example' and ʿabīr 'fragrance'. Aabir therefore means “Passer-by; one who crosses; transient”. Arabic active participle ʿābir 'one who crosses, passer-by'; used as a given name.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aabir expresses “The Last”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From Arabic ʿābir (عابر) 'one who crosses, passer-by', the active participle of ʿabara 'to cross, to pass through', from the root ʿ-b-r. The same root gives ʿibra 'lesson, example' and ʿabīr 'fragrance'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aabir total 22, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.

faq.q: What does the root ʿ-b-r mean in Aabir?
faq.a: The Arabic root ʿ-b-r (ع-ب-ر) means 'to cross, to pass through'. Aabir is its active participle, so it means 'one who crosses' or 'passer-by'. The same root gives ʿibra 'a lesson' and ʿabīr 'fragrance'.

faq.q: What does the name Aabir mean?
faq.a: Aabir means “Passer-by; one who crosses; transient”.

faq.q: Where does the name Aabir come from?
What is the linguistic root of Aabir?
faq.a: The root of Aabir is ع-ب-ر (ʿ-b-r).

faq.q: How is Aabir written in Arabic script?
faq.a: Aabir is written عابر in Arabic script.

faq.q: Is Aabir a boy's or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aabir is used as a male name.

faq.q: Does Aabir appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: No. Aabir is not a Qur'anic name; it is used in Muslim naming tradition.

faq.q: Is the meaning of Aabir verified?
faq.a: Yes — the meaning “Passer-by; one who crosses; transient” is established by Arabic active participle ʿābir 'one who crosses, passer-by'; used as a given name..
